html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=Literata:opsz,wght@7..72,500;7..72,600&display=swap');
  /* A product's documentation on an 80rem page: a site bar (brand, sections, search, the look and the language), the
     docs navigation in a quiet column, the article in a 46rem reading measure with its code on dark panels. IBM Plex
     Sans to read, Plex Mono for code. Looks: Manual (white and blue, follows light / dark), Console (warm black, amber,
     the headings in Plex Mono) and Field guide (paper and forest green, Literata headings). */
  #site-docs {
    --background: oklch(0.995 0.002 250);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.02 255);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.965 0.006 250);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.48 0.02 255);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.02 255 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.02 255 / 0.2);
    --primary: oklch(0.52 0.19 258);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.003 250);
    --secondary: oklch(0.96 0.02 255);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.4 0.16 258);
    --accent: oklch(0.955 0.025 258);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.4 0.16 258);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --docs-heading: 'IBM Plex Sans', var(--font-sans);
    color-scheme: light;
    container-type: inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: max(44rem, var(--scaffold-height, 0px));
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.6 'IBM Plex Sans',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  .dark #site-docs[data-look='manual'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.18 0.012 255);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.006 250);
    --card: oklch(0.21 0.014 255);
    --muted: oklch(0.235 0.016 255);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0.015 250);
    --border: oklch(0.94 0.006 250 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(0.94 0.006 250 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.74 0.13 255);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.18 0.012 255);
    --secondary: oklch(0.27 0.04 258);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.06 255);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.04 258);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.06 255);
  }
  #site-docs[data-look='console'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.165 0.008 60);
    --foreground: oklch(0.93 0.02 85);
    --card: oklch(0.195 0.01 60);
    --muted: oklch(0.215 0.012 60);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.73 0.03 80);
    --border: oklch(0.93 0.02 85 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(0.93 0.02 85 / 0.22);
    --primary: oklch(0.81 0.14 75);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.165 0.008 60);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.03 70);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.08 80);
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.04 70);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.1 80);
    --radius: 0.25rem;
    --docs-heading: 'IBM Plex Mono', var(--font-mono);
  }
  #site-docs[data-look='field'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.972 0.012 115);
    --foreground: oklch(0.26 0.05 155);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.008 110);
    --muted: oklch(0.94 0.018 120);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.045 150);
    --border: oklch(0.26 0.05 155 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.26 0.05 155 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.44 0.11 155);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.008 110);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0.035 135);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.32 0.08 155);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.035 135);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.32 0.08 155);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --docs-heading: 'Literata', Georgia, serif;
  }
  /* code in syntax colours: the token spans carry both themes; the listing's ground picks one */
  #site-docs [data-code-ground='light'] code span[style*='--shiki-light'] {
    color: var(--shiki-light);
  }
  #site-docs [data-code-ground='dark'] code span[style*='--shiki-dark'] {
    color: var(--shiki-dark);
  }
  #site-docs [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  #site-docs > :not(template) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 80rem) / 2));
  }
  /* the site bar */
  #site-docs .docs-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem 2rem;
    min-height: 4.25rem;
    padding-block: 0.75rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-docs .docs-brand {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-brand svg {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .docs-brand span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-top {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.5rem;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-top a {
    padding-block: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-top a:hover,
  #site-docs .docs-top a[aria-current] {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-docs .docs-top a[aria-current] {
    box-shadow: 0 2px var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .docs-search {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-width: min(100%, 15rem);
    height: 2.25rem;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    padding: 0 0.375rem 0 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--muted);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-search svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-search kbd {
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    padding: 0.0625rem 0.375rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: var(--background);
    font:
      500 0.75rem 'IBM Plex Mono',
      var(--font-mono);
  }
  #site-docs .docs-search:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-bar-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-bar .select {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 7.5rem;
  }
  /* the navigation beside the article */
  #site-docs .docs-layout {
    display: grid;
    flex: 1;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 2.5rem;
    align-items: start;
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem) clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  }
  @container (width > 56rem) {
    #site-docs .docs-layout {
      grid-template-columns: 15rem minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem);
    }
    #site-docs .docs-side {
      position: sticky;
      top: 1.5rem;
    }
  }
  #site-docs .docs-side {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-navigation {
    max-width: none;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-navigation-heading {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-navigation a[aria-current] {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  /* the article */
  #site-docs .docs-main {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content {
    max-width: 46rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-docs :is(.mk-docs-content-title, .mk-docs-content-prose h2) {
    font-family: var(--docs-heading);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-title {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.625rem);
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-lead {
    font-size: 1.1875rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-prose {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-prose h2 {
    margin-block-start: 2.5rem;
    padding-block-start: 2rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
  #site-docs :is(code, pre, kbd) {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', var(--font-mono);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-prose pre {
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-code-block {
    margin-block: 1.25rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-callout {
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-callout:not([data-tone]) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 8%, transparent);
    & svg,
    & strong {
      color: var(--primary);
    }
  }
  #site-docs .mk-docs-content-pager a {
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  }
  /* narrow: the search takes its own row, the sections scroll sideways */
  @container (width < 40rem) {
    #site-docs .docs-top {
      order: 3;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      width: 100%;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }
    #site-docs .docs-top a {
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #site-docs .docs-search {
      order: 2;
      flex: 1 1 100%;
      margin-inline-start: 0;
    }
    #site-docs .docs-bar-controls {
      order: 1;
    }
  }
  /* light or dark: the Swap writes the page's dark class - every look has a light and a dark palette */
  #site-docs .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-docs .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  /* -- modes: each look in light and dark, derived from the palettes above (the other mode of each look) -- */
  :root:not(.dark) #site-docs[data-look='manual'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.95 0.025 258);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.22 0.02 255);
  }
  .dark #site-docs[data-look='manual'] {
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.006 250);
  }
  .dark #site-docs[data-look='console'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.255 0.04 70);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.93 0.02 85);
  }
  :root:not(.dark) #site-docs[data-look='console'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.008 60);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.02 85);
    --card: oklch(0.997 0.01 60);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.02 85);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0.012 60);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.03 80);
    --border: oklch(0.2 0.02 85 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(0.2 0.02 85 / 0.12);
    --primary: oklch(0.56 0.14 75);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.005 75);
    --secondary: oklch(0.955 0.025 70);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.25 0.03 80);
    --accent: oklch(0.94 0.025 70);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.02 85);
    --ring: oklch(0.56 0.14 75);
    --popover: oklch(0.997 0 0);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.2 0 0);
  }
  :root:not(.dark) #site-docs[data-look='field'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.927 0.035 135);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.26 0.05 155);
  }
  .dark #site-docs[data-look='field'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.17 0.012 115);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.03 155);
    --card: oklch(0.205 0.008 110);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.03 155);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0.018 120);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0.03 150);
    --border: oklch(0.95 0.02 155 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.95 0.02 155 / 0.14);
    --primary: oklch(0.68 0.11 155);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.03 155);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.035 135);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.03 155);
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.035 135);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.03 155);
    --ring: oklch(0.68 0.11 155);
    --popover: oklch(0.215 0 0);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.94 0 0);
  }
  /* -- modes: end -- */
  /* the views below the bar take the rest of the height; the dialogs hold nothing in the flow */
  #site-docs > [data-docs-view] {
    flex: 1;
  }
  #site-docs > .docs-dialogs {
    display: contents;
  }
  /* the edit link of a page is a button: it opens the suggestion dialog */
  #site-docs .docs-edit {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-edit:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-docs .docs-edit:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* the front page of the docs: the sections as cards */
  #site-docs .docs-home {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    max-width: 58rem;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-home-eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-home .mk-docs-content-title,
  #site-docs .docs-home .mk-docs-content-lead {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-home-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-block-start: 1rem;
  }
  #site-docs :is(.docs-home, .docs-help) .mk-help-category-title {
    font-family: var(--docs-heading);
  }
  #site-docs :is(.docs-home, .docs-help) .mk-help-category-body {
    align-content: start;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-list .mk-release-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  }
  /* the release notes: the versions in a rail beside the releases */
  #site-docs .docs-changelog {
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem) clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  }
  #site-docs .rl-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }
  @container (width > 52rem) {
    #site-docs .rl-layout {
      grid-template-columns: 11rem minmax(0, 46rem);
      gap: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem);
    }
    #site-docs .rl-rail {
      position: sticky;
      top: 1.5rem;
    }
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail {
    align-self: start;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail h2 {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail ol {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail a {
    display: grid;
    margin-inline-start: -1px;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem;
    border-inline-start: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail a b {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail a:hover b {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail a[aria-current] {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .rl-rail a[aria-current] b {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .rl-main {
    display: grid;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-head {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-head > * {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 3rem;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-release-header {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 0 2rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-release-header-title {
    font-family: var(--docs-heading);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-release-header-title a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-release-header-title a:hover {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .rl-items {
    display: grid;
  }
  #site-docs .rl-main > .mk-release-header-links {
    margin: 0;
  }
  /* the help centre: one question and the search on a tinted band, then the topics and more to read */
  #site-docs > .docs-help {
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    padding-inline: 0;
  }
  #site-docs .docs-help > * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 80rem) / 2));
  }
  #site-docs .hc-hero {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    background:
      radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 12%, transparent), transparent 70%),
      var(--muted);
    text-align: center;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-hero h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--docs-heading);
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-search {
    position: relative;
    width: min(100%, 36rem);
  }
  #site-docs .hc-search svg {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 1rem;
    width: 1.125rem;
    height: 1.125rem;
    translate: 0 -50%;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-search .input {
    height: 3.25rem;
    padding-inline-start: 2.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--background);
    font-size: 1rem;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -18px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
  }
  #site-docs .hc-popular {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-popular a {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-section {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem) 0;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-section:last-child {
    padding-block-end: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
  }
  #site-docs .hc-section > h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--docs-heading);
    font-size: 1.375rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  }
  #site-docs :is(.hc-grid, .hc-resources) {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 17rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
  }
  #site-docs .hc-results {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    max-width: 46rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-results a {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-docs .hc-results a:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-docs .hc-results a span,
  #site-docs .hc-none {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  /* one help article in the reading measure */
  #site-docs .docs-article {
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem) clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  }
  #site-docs .mk-help-article {
    max-width: 42rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  #site-docs .mk-help-article-title {
    font-family: var(--docs-heading);

        <h1 class="mk-docs-content-title" id="dc-title" data-docs-title>Offline sync</h1>

            <code>Settings → Sync</code>, or install the CLI:</p

              <button

                data-i18n-aria-label-de="Code kopieren"

          <p data-i18n-target="os-p4"

Change your billing email

Updated 12 Sep 2026 · 2 min read

Invoices and payment reminders go to the billing email. Only workspace owners can change it.

  1. Open Settings

    Press ⌘ , or choose Settings from your avatar menu.

  2. Go to Billing → Details

    You'll see the current billing email under "Invoices".

  3. Enter the new address and save

    We send a confirmation link to the new address. The change applies once it is confirmed.

Use a shared address like billing@yourcompany.com so invoices don't depend on one person.

Still stuck?

If you can't see Billing, you're not an owner of this workspace. Ask an owner, or contact support.
